name: agent-teams
description: DRI-led agent teams: the /dri playbook, five role agents, a global learning workspace and initiative registry. Hard-requires beads (bd).

use_advisors.title: Use advisors
use_advisors.description: When enabled, background DRI sessions run on sonnet with an advisor attached (--model sonnet --advisor <dri_model>) instead of the default <dri_model>-only session. The advisor's model comes from the dri_model option.

dri_model.title: DRI model
dri_model.description: The 'strong model' slot: when advisors are enabled, this is the advisor's model (the DRI session worker stays sonnet); when advisors are disabled, this is the DRI session's own model. Defaults to "opus", which resolves to a native 1M-context model — no [1m] suffix needed. When auto_compact_window is left empty (the default), background sessions don't pin an auto-compact window, so whatever model is set here also decides the compaction threshold: a 200k-context model here means compaction near 167k tokens. Set auto_compact_window to override that.

auto_compact_window.title: Auto-compact window
auto_compact_window.description: Token window agent-teams requests for the background sessions it launches (DRI and steward), passed straight to Claude Code's --autocompact flag. Empty = send nothing, letting Claude Code resolve the window from the model — for a 1M-context model that means ~967000. A value here can only LOWER the window, never raise it above the model's real one. Note this is the WINDOW, not the trigger: compaction fires roughly 33000 tokens below it (the engine reserves min(max_output_tokens, 20000) + 13000). Accepts anything Claude Code's --autocompact accepts: 100k-1M as a plain number (450000), with a k/m suffix (500k, 1m), a bare 100-1000 as thousands shorthand (200 means 200000), or the literal 'auto' to ignore any autoCompactWindow in your settings and let Claude Code resolve it. An out-of-range or unparseable value makes the launch fail loudly with Claude Code's own error message.
